title: Synthesize Pairing Table
description: Pairing table that every audit must produce before the Report stage starts. Each row pairs a trust-source with a trust-consumer (see SKILL.md Hard Gate). The runtime validate-notes CLI enforces this schema; a missing table or a row with no file:line proof is a hard failure.

rows.description: Every dangerous primitive crossed with every reachable trust-consumer. An empty array is a hard failure - it means the audit did not enumerate.

trust_source.description: Component that produces / writes / trusts value X. Typically a handler name, callback id, plugin name, or endpoint id.

trust_consumer.description: Component that reads / consumes X but lacks a fresh authorization check. Typically a sink (unserialize / include / eval / file-write / permission-decision) or a downstream endpoint / service.

status.description: Result of pairwise analysis. upgraded = chain survives with file:line proof on every hop. DISPROVED = chain dies at a specific hop, named in rationale. NEEDS-RUNTIME = static analysis could not close, mark for runtime verification.

file_line.description: file:line or file:start-end reference for the trust-source or the first hop. Empty or vague values are rejected.

rationale.description: One sentence explaining why this row exists and why the chosen status holds.

coverage_paragraph_present.description: The notes file must contain a Coverage paragraph (SKILL.md Coverage rule). This field is a structural assertion that it does.
